Operation

Carry out a preliminary visual inspection to locate the component or the area which is giving rise to the leak.

If the visual inspection is insufficient, wash the engine, dry it and start it slowly until it reaches operating temperature: to identify the leak, if necessary, carry out the system leakage test Op. 0510C30
